race.title: Aubrey Bealby ABH Tipster Champion Novices' Handicap Chase
race.verdict: Not the easiest race to assess but CHATTY GIRL showed some promise on her first start in this sphere at Fontwell and can build on it on the back of a breathing operation to add to her debut bumper success. The returning Ahanaglogh could emerge as the main danger for his in-form yard, with Natus Vincere and Dance Rules also worth a look. CHATTY GIRL (IRE) AHANAGLOGH (IRE) NATUS VINCERE (IRE)
